regional.lanternhold: Ethiopian highland-inspired fantasy: warm brown skin, braided or closely cropped natural hair, white woven cotton shawl with rich colored woven borders over library robes, small silver filigree jewelry and scroll cases
regional.thornbury: Southern American frontier-inspired fantasy: practical waxed canvas coat, homespun and leather, green Warden sash where relevant; natural braids or locs when specified
regional.dunmere: Welsh valley-inspired fantasy: fair skin, wool flat cap, thick knitted wool and leather apron, slate embroidery; dwarf has a broad compact build and elaborately braided beard
regional.umbra: Kenyan-inspired forest fantasy: deep brown skin, small precise beadwork, red-and-black checked woven cloth, bark and hide, close locs, ochre markings
regional.gate: Yoruba and Igbo-inspired Nigerian fantasy city: deep brown skin, distinct individual African facial features, woven aso-oke panels, coral beads, carefully fitted layered cloth; rulers in grand agbada or gele; soldiers flame-red tabards; merchants dark tailored city coats
regional.elves: Japanese-inspired woodland ELF: pointed ears, olive skin, muted layered travelling kimono-cut jacket and hakama, high-tied dark hair, lacquered bow case, understated practical elegance
regional.deep: Arab-inspired DARK ELF: ashen grey skin, long white hair, pointed ears, flowing black and indigo robes, intricate silver geometric embroidery, a half veil that really covers the mouth, kohl-lined eyes
regional.kalden: Turkish-inspired steppe fantasy: olive skin, embroidered kaftan, felt details and evil-eye bead jewelry; ranger has wolf-fur collar and witch has elegant embroidered violet robes
regional.vashk: Indian-inspired mage: brown skin, crimson silk sherwani-cut robes, intricate gold embroidery, jeweled turban pin, many rings, polished imperious bearing
regional.hand: Jamaican-inspired fantasy travellers: brown skin, sea-faded linen, hidden red-gold-green sash; Desmond has long locs, Winston has cropped hair and a compact HALFLING build
regional.flame: Mexican-inspired paladin: olive skin, neat black hair, charro-style embroidered leather over mail, white tabard with stylized sunrise emblem, rosary of small red beads
regional.none: Invented fantasy monster anatomy with NO real-world ethnic or national visual coding
